title: Spanish Papelon Onigiri
description: A unique Catalan dish featuring papelon, shaped like nigiri, and served in a terracotta dish, perfect for a light snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the crushed papelon, cooked rice, olive oil, and salt until well combined.
Add the beaten egg and water to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a triangle, like nigiri.
Place the shaped onigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the onigiri in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned on the bottom.
Remove the onigiri from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the onigiri in a terracotta dish, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped parsley.
